text:
marco: Quick heads-up, I'm starting Nebula7b onboarding (Mistral-derived) on the int4 path, and I'm hitting a weird rotary/kvcache mismatch on our runtime.

lina: curious — mismatch how? shapes? token ids?

marco: logs show `rotary_scale` roughly identical but the per-head phase seems shifted by a constant offset. sample log: `rotary_phase: expected 64, got 66 for head 3` then downstream kvcache hits non-determinism on longctx tests.

asha: could be a tokenmap/vocab offset during conversion. Did you run `convert-weights --tokenmap` when exporting from the vendor checkpoint?

marco: yes I ran the usual exporter, command I used:
```
./export_weights \--input nebula_ckpt.pt \--output nebula.onnx \--quant int4 \--tokenmap auto
```
No explicit offset passed.

sam: try forcing `--tokenmap shift:1` as a quick probe, and run the kvcache interop smoke (longcontext with synthetic prefix). sometimes tokenizer BOM or BOS indexing causes this.

marco: will try. also ran eval harness (summaries + rouge) on cnn/dailymail at int4 vs fp16: int4 BLEU-ish/ROUGE dropped ~2.8 points and we see hallucination cases where repeated entity tokens pop up.

eval-bot: run 1748202468-eval-01 completed. metrics: ROUGE-L fp16=45.2, int4=42.4; perplexity fp16=12.1, int4=12.4. diff flagged on 12 prompts.

lina: perf delta small but the quality change is suspicious — if rotary misalignment it'll affect attention patterns nonlinearly. Have you compared raw logits on the same tokens between fp16 and int4?

marco: I dumped logits for sample id=nebu-042 and saw a consistent phase-shifted attention distribution for positions > 128. I'll attach a minimal dump shortly.

asha: also verify rotary implementation: some exporters fold head-dim ordering (head-major vs head-minor). check `head_stride`/`proj_order` in the model meta. mismatch there explains per-head scale differences.

sam: good point. add `--head-order=head_first` vs `--head-order=proj_first` to the convert tool to see if it fixes it.

marco: quick test with `--tokenmap shift:1 --head-order=proj_first` re-exported, re-ran quant pipeline, smoke longctx kvcache looks stable now (no nondet). preparing eval run.

deploy-bot: conversion job 1748202468-conv-02 started on runner-12. artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/nebula/1748202468-conv-02.tar.gz

eval-bot: run 1748202468-eval-02 queued (int4 + tokenmap shift+head-order). estimated time 18m.

marco: early peek at a few examples — repeat hallucinations gone in those cases, attention heatmaps align better with fp16.

lina: nice. still want a small automated check: add a kvcache roundtrip test that loads fp16 and int4 and asserts top-k token logits for first 256 positions are within epsilon (maybe top-3 match on >95% of positions).

asha: I'll add that to the conversion CI as a soft-fail gating (warn on regression). helps prevent regressions during future quant CI.

sam: also file a tiny note in model-metadata: `rotary_phase_offset=+2` if we decide to keep tokenmap shift for this model so others know.

marco: created an issue #ML-nebula-rotary with logs, conversion flags, and sample diffs. Also attaching the small logits dump and kvcache heatmaps.

eval-bot: run 1748202468-eval-02 completed. metrics: ROUGE-L fp16=45.2, int4=45.0; perplexity fp16=12.1, int4=12.15. regression resolved.

marco: thanks all. action items: 1) add head-order and tokenmap tests to convert CI (asha), 2) add kvcache topk check to eval harness (lina), 3) annotate model-metadata with rotary/tokenmap note (sam).

lina: added checklist item to onboarding template.

asha: starting the CI patch now. ETA today.

sam: I'll update model-metadata and include the conversion flags.

marco: great, closing the triage for now. will reopen if further odd cases show up. :thumbsup:
